zh.title: 空中巴士測試加長機翼 研發高效能下一代窄體客機
zh.summary: 空中巴士正測試加長翼展設計，期望提升下一代窄體客機的整體能源效率。
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，飛機製造商空中巴士目前正在對加長機翼的全新設計進行實際測試，以期能顯著提升未來客機的整體能源效率。這項試驗顯示出空中巴士希望藉由創新技術，引領未來民航機設計的發展趨勢。
此項加長機翼的技術測試，被認為有可能成為空中巴士下一代窄體客機研發過程中的最大設計變革。該公司期望能透過拉長翼展，為未來的航空客運市場提供更加節能且高效能的全新單走道飛機方案。

en.title: Airbus Tests Longer Wings for More Efficient Next-Generation Narrowbody Aircraft
en.summary: Airbus tests longer wings to improve efficiency for its next narrowbody aircraft.
body: According to a report by aviation news outlet Simple Flying, aircraft manufacturer Airbus is currently testing a longer wing design in an effort to pioneer future aerospace developments. The company hopes this testing will pave the way for making future commercial aircraft far more efficient, aiming to lead the industry in aircraft design innovation.

This exploration of longer wings could ultimately represent the most significant design change for Airbus' next-generation narrowbody aircraft. By testing extended wingspans, the manufacturer plans to evaluate new methods for improving the overall fuel efficiency and performance of its future single-aisle aircraft families.
